work.title: Face With Planes
work.description: Five iridescent compact discs are arranged as facial features — eyes, nose, and chin — within a lightly drawn face outline on white paper. Three top-down warplane silhouettes punctuate the composition, flanking the eyes and bridging the nose area, with a photographic mouth element at center.
work.composition: face assembled from CDs and warplanes
work.dimensions_source: cd-reference: 3 CDs measured (4.8% spread), mean 240.8px dia = 51.02px/in, applied to 2052x2800 native. Circle fit confirmed against disc edge at high zoom. Verified 2026-08-04.
